changes_made.explanation: Removed redundant dataset references ('Amazon test set' is part of SUMMEVAL-OP, 'OPIN-SUMMEVAL' normalized to 'OPINSUMMEVAL'), kept main dataset names only
Normalized ROUGE variants to base ROUGE metric as per simplification rules

Added GPT-4 which is mentioned as being tested as evaluator, removed open-source models that were only used for generation but not evaluation. The paper explicitly tests ChatGPT-3.5 and Mistral-7B as evaluators, with GPT-4 mentioned as a limitation due to cost constraints.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on opinion summarization evaluation using LLMs as judges. The extraction was generally accurate but needed some refinement: (1) dataset names were redundant, (2) ROUGE variants needed normalization, (3) LLM evaluators needed clarification (only ChatGPT-3.5 and Mistral-7B were actually tested as evaluators), (4) human evaluation details were incomplete. The paper is strong in evaluation methodology with comprehensive human evaluation and LLM-as-judge experiments.
